channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Nikola Jokic | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Nikola Jokic from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Deni Avdija on Nikola Jokic
item.description:
Deni Avdija on why it is impossible to guard Nikola Jokic:

“Every time I switch on to Jokic, I’m like, what the hell am I supposed to do? This guy is strong, smart, can pass, and has those touch floaters from every angle.”

Deni Avdija on Nikola Jokic, Oct 12, 2026. Source: reddit.

item.title: Ben Tenzer on Nikola Jokic
item.description:
Chris Dempsey:#Nuggets co-GM Ben Tenzer on how the organization feels about the Nikola Jokic contract situation:

“We feel very comfortable with the relationship, the trust there. We have no concerns.”

Ben Tenzer on Nikola Jokic, Sep 28, 2026. Source: Twitter @chrisadempsey.

item.title: Peyton Watson on Nikola Jokic
item.description:
Oh No He Didn't: Peyton Watson on what he learned from playing with Nikola Jokic:

“Ithink my IQ for the game has gotten a lot better just playing with him. Knowing how to play with a superstar is something that's invaluable in this league with so much talent. I think you need to always know how to play off of other players and how to make other players better, even if you don't necessarily have the ball in your hands”

Peyton Watson on Nikola Jokic, Sep 17, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Draymond Green on LeBron James, Kawhi Leonard, Nikola Jokic, Shai Gilgeous-Alexander
item.description:
Draymond Green:

“We all get a licensing check. LeBron James, Steph Curry, Kawhi Leonard, Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, Nikola Jokic, they all get the same jersey sales as the rookie. Excuse me, as a rookie, you don't get a license check because the license check is from a year before. But say a second-year guy who didn't play much on a team, and the license check was 500 grand, that's jersey sales. That's all of the licensing things, right? That same 500 grand that that second-year guy gets, Steph Curry gets. It's divvied up, it's even split. And so, you could make 300,000, you could make 500,000, but every player makes the same amount.”

Draymond Green on LeBron James, Kawhi Leonard, Nikola Jokic, Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, Sep 11, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Nikola Jokic, Kristaps Porzingis
item.description:
Durant asked.

“It's the Americans who had an influence on them. It's cool that some of them won MVP awards, but who did they look up to. Jokic, Porzingis, Shai, they all wore Iverson's jerseys and imitated his crossovers. They try to play like us and they succeeded in their own way.”

Kevin Durant on Nikola Jokic, Kristaps Porzingis, Aug 29, 2026. Source: BasketNews.

item.title: Vincent Collet on Nikola Jokic
item.description:
Vincent Collet:

“On the other hand, I think (Nikola) Jokic is the best offensive player. The way he creates for his teammates while also scoring with very high efficiency makes him a real threat to any team. If you have Jokic, you have a good team, regardless of who plays with him. When he plays for Serbia, he has many good players around him, and he is the one who makes the others better. He has so many qualities, but the main one is his ability to make his teammates better.”

Vincent Collet on Nikola Jokic, Aug 18, 2026. Source: EuroHoops.net.

item.title: Misko Raznatovic on Nikola Jokic
item.description:
The Greek businessman maintained that the offer was genuine, with Jokic’s longtime agent, Misko Raznatovic, subsequently confirming his account in a statement to Mozzart Sport.

“Everything Dimitris said in his interview with Euro Insiders regarding the offer to Nikola Jokic is true. In 30 years of working in this business, I have never encountered an offer like that. Given the very direct relationship I have with him, I immediately explained that the offer could not be considered,”

Misko Raznatovic on Nikola Jokic, Aug 11, 2026. Source: EuroHoops.net.

item.title: Ben Tenzer on Nikola Jokic
item.description:
Bennett Durando:Ben Tenzer:

“We just can't comment on (extension progress with Nikola Jokic) because of the league rules, but you've heard what he's said about his happiness here. We feel really comfortable with that relationship.”

Ben Tenzer on Nikola Jokic, Jun 24, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Rich Paul on LeBron James, Nikola Jokic
item.description:
Rich Paul on why the media doesn’t criticize Nikola Jokic like they do LeBron:

“The reason you don’t hear a lot of conversation about Jokic, is because I don’t believe people are happy to see Jokic lose. When LeBron loses, people are happy to see him lose. Especially his peers. Guys that played in the league who have platforms today, for different reasons, it’s extra. They are happy to see him lose.”

Rich Paul on LeBron James, Nikola Jokic, May 4, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Shaquille O'Neal on Nikola Jokic
item.description:
Shaq on Wemby:

“In two years he will be right next to Jokic as the best big in the league. Right now he's number 2 but not far behind. He's playing excellent basketball and i'm happy for the young fella”

Shaquille O'Neal on Nikola Jokic, Apr 28, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Rudy Gobert on Nikola Jokic
item.description:
Oh No He Didn't: Rudy Gobert on guarding Nikola Jokic:

“He's the greatest offensive player I've guarded my whole career. Just tryimg to enjoy the challenge and make him work as much as I can...keep trying to make him earn everything he gets”

Rudy Gobert on Nikola Jokic, Apr 24, 2026. Source: Twitter.

item.title: David Adelman on Nikola Jokic
item.description:
Bennett Durando:David Adelman on Nikola Jokic passing up the floater:

“You always want him to shoot that shot. But he sees what he sees out there. He’s playing. And if he sees his teammate open, he’s gonna make that play.… I trust the best player in the world to make the decisions he makes.”

David Adelman on Nikola Jokic, Apr 21, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Julius Randle on Nikola Jokic
item.description:
Julius Randle on defending Jokic:

“Probably gotta call God and talk to him for a little bit and ask him for a few favors. It’s going to be a tough matchup. He’s an incredible player. ... It’s going to be a battle, but we’re prepared. We’re ready for it.”

Julius Randle on Nikola Jokic, Apr 15, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Victor Wembanyama on Nikola Jokic
item.description:
Jared Weiss:Victor Wembanyama on battling Nikola Jokic:

“I think it was an amazing game. Very fun. One of the most fun games. I wish we could’ve closed it out. My conclusion of this game is that it was good for us. It’s a real test against a team that’s actually playing for something right now.”

Victor Wembanyama on Nikola Jokic, Apr 4, 2026. Source: Twitter @JaredWeissNBA.

item.title: Marc Spears on Nikola Jokic
item.description:
Oh No He Didn't: Marc Spears on Jokic:

“I'm actually hearing that the Nuggets are a little concerned about how he's being defended of late. Teams are guarding him 18 feet from the basket, leaning on his legs, fronting him, putting their arms around him but he's still figuring out a way to ball out”

Marc Spears on Nikola Jokic, Mar 23, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Charlie Villanueva on Nikola Jokic
item.description:
Charlie Villanueva on Jokic saying he never wants to leave the Nuggets:

“Most European superstars don't want to leave their team. These international cats don’t have the same mentality as a US born player where if sh*t don’t go right we want to leave,you know, they want to fix the problems.”

Charlie Villanueva on Nikola Jokic, Mar 10, 2026. Source: reddit.

item.title: David Adelman on Nikola Jokic
item.description:
David Adelman on Nikola Jokic vs Smalls:

“We have to get used to the way Nikola is guarded, and if teams are allowed to go at his knees and grip his waist and pull his jersey out, and that's marginal contact, then we have to deal with that. That's just the way it is.”

David Adelman on Nikola Jokic, Mar 4, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Will Hardy on Nikola Jokic
item.description:
“There have been some other teams in the league that have guarded Jokic with smalls, and it’s about trying to wear him down make catches tough,”

Will Hardy on Nikola Jokic, Mar 3, 2026. Source: Larry Brown Sports.

item.title: David Adelman on Nikola Jokic
item.description:
David Adelman on Jokic:

“I think his frustration is sometimes because the game's officiated differently out on the floor than it is near the basket. I think he was reacting to what was being done to him. When we play them again whatever it is in like 10 days I'm sure it'll be the exact same way”

David Adelman on Nikola Jokic, Feb 28, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Michael Malone on Nikola Jokic
item.description:
MrBuckBuck:Michael Malone on Nikola Jokic:

“When I coached him, I had a hard time getting him to sit.”

Michael Malone on Nikola Jokic, Feb 5, 2026. Source: Twitter.

item.title: LeBron James on Nikola Jokic
item.description:
“I mean, for the greats of the game, for the greats of today, the greats of the past, the greats that come after. Jokic is one of the greatest players to ever play this game.”

LeBron James on Nikola Jokic, Jan 21, 2026. Source: Denver Post.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Nikola Jokic
item.description:
“One thing I don't want to see with Nikola is like, they started calling me 'injury prone' after that, but hopefully they don't start with him because it's one of those freak injuries that you can't really control,”

Kevin Durant on Nikola Jokic, Jan 1, 2026. Source: ESPN.

item.title: David Adelman on Nikola Jokic
item.description:
Adelman on how Jokic is coping with his injury:

“He’s in a good place. He always is never too high and every now and then hilariously low.”

David Adelman on Nikola Jokic, Dec 31, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: David Adelman on Nikola Jokic
item.description:
David Adelman on Jokic's knee injury:

“It's an unfortunate situation. Silver lining, it's not season ending but it was a very concerning moment for us... not just because of the player he is, it's because I know him... He's 1 of the tougher people & players I've ever been around”

David Adelman on Nikola Jokic, Dec 31, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: David Adelman on Nikola Jokic
item.description:
MrBuckBuck: David Adelman on Nikola Jokic's injury:

“This is part of the NBA. It sucks, but hoping for the best tomorrow.”

David Adelman on Nikola Jokic, Dec 29, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Victor Wembanyama on Giannis Antetokounmpo, Nikola Jokic, Shai Gilgeous-Alexander
item.description:
Speaking with ESPN, Victor Wembanyama was asked who the NBA’s best player is:

“Jokić is the best offensive player … I don’t think he’s the best player. (It’s) between Giannis (Antetokounmpo) and Shai (Gilgeous-Alexander). “When I come back to the court, it will be me.”

Victor Wembanyama on Giannis Antetokounmpo, Nikola Jokic, Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, Dec 12, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Derik Queen on Nikola Jokic
item.description:
MrBuckBuck: Derik Queen on talking to Jokic mid-game:

“I tried to say something to him but he didnt really say nothing”

Derik Queen on Nikola Jokic, Nov 20, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Christian Braun on Nikola Jokic
item.description:
Braun:

“I just think that I always have something to prove. I think that’s everybody’s job in this league – that’s to come in each year, add something and continue to prove who you are. I got new guys that are older, are All-Stars and new coaches. I got to prove stuff to the new staff. I got to continue to prove stuff to Nikola, Jamal and Aaron. So I feel like I always have something to prove to somebody. This year, we have a whole new staff. So it adds a couple of things.”

Christian Braun on Nikola Jokic, Oct 3, 2025. Source: SportsKeeda.

item.title: David Adelman on Marc Gasol, Nikola Jokic
item.description:
Adelman on possibly playing more drop w/Jokic:

“He won't be just at the rim like he's Gobert ...I think what we're trying to create with him, he's so high-IQ, is the Marc Gasol model where he's choosing his levels depending on the quality of player or what the player does well.”

David Adelman on Marc Gasol, Nikola Jokic, Oct 3, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Vassilis Spanoulis on Giannis Antetokounmpo, Nikola Jokic, Lauri Markkanen, Alperen Sengun
item.description:
Vassilis Spanoulis:

“At least to times, he should have been awarded unsportmanlike fouls, and we have to face everybody with the same criteria. If we face Luka, Jokic, and Sengun, Markkanen, like this, we have to face Giannis the same way. Just 12 free throws are few for Giannis; he could have had another 10 for sure. We have a team in which we respect everybody, and first of all, me, as a person, I respect a lot coach Scariolo and Spain, which has accomplished amazing things over the last 15 years, but I have to be fair with myself and the game, and to say the truth”

Vassilis Spanoulis on Giannis Antetokounmpo, Nikola Jokic, Lauri Markkanen, Alperen Sengun, Sep 4, 2025. Source: EuroHoops.net.
